name: Find Email
description: Find an email using Google's Search Engine. [See the docs](https://developers.google.com/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages/list)

configurable_props.name: q
configurable_props.label: Search Query
configurable_props.description: Apply a search filter using Gmail's [standard search operators](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7190)

configurable_props.name: withTextPayload
configurable_props.label: Return payload as plaintext
configurable_props.description: Convert the payload response into a single text field. **This reduces the size of the payload and makes it easier for LLMs work with.**

configurable_props.name: metadataOnly
configurable_props.label: Metadata Only
configurable_props.description: Only return metadata for the messages. This reduces the size of the payload and makes it easier for LLMs work with.

configurable_props.name: labels
configurable_props.label: Labels
configurable_props.description: Only return messages with labels that match all of the specified labels.

configurable_props.name: includeSpamTrash
configurable_props.label: Include Spam and Trash?
configurable_props.description: Include messages from `SPAM` and `TRASH` in the results. Defaults to `false`.

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Defaults to `20`.
